intro.title: Controlled Input
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple form with a text input field that displays its current value in real-time. You will learn the concept of a controlled input, where React state becomes the single source of truth for the input's value. The main technologies involved are React's useState hook and TypeScript for type safety. By the end, you'll understand how to synchronize form data with component state, a fundamental pattern in React applications.
intro.usecase: Controlled inputs are essential for any interactive form where you need real-time validation and immediate user feedback. You'll use them in login/registration forms to validate email formats and password strength as users type. They're also critical in dashboard filters where changing one input should instantly update charts and tables, or in e-commerce product configurators where selecting options updates pricing dynamically. This pattern gives developers complete control over form state and behavior.
